scripts.setup: uv sync && npm ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && npx playwright install chromium
scripts.start: npm --prefix frontend run build && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8765
scripts.gen-api: uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py && npm --prefix frontend run gen-api
scripts.lint-py: uv run ruff check backend scripts desktop && uv run ruff format --check backend scripts desktop
scripts.test-api-contract: uv run pytest -k openapi_contract && npm --prefix frontend run gen-api:check
scripts.test-live-smoke: node -e "console.log('No live providers exist yet (Phase 3+). Nothing to run.')"
scripts.check: npm run lint-py && npm run typecheck-py && npm run typecheck-ui && npm run lint-ui && npm run test-api-contract && npm run test-backend && npm run test-frontend
